items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: He said he worked for Hall's... Who else is in the band? I didn't know everybody in the band.

ctx.x: I don't know, was he? I don't know, was he right there Barry or somebody else?

No, no, no, he said no, he said he worked... Barry did go there, but... He said he worked for Hall's... Yeah, no, no, no. He said he worked for Hall's drum. Who else is in the band? I didn't know everybody in the band.
Who's the pianist? Oh, well, Wiggins. Oh, that's right.
